summary: node1 now has a 1 GiB LUKS1 encrypted ext4 volume mounted read/write at /srv/secure. A dedicated OpenRC service automatically attaches, unlocks, and mounts it after local filesystems become writable. Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged.

Created and enabled the secure-volume OpenRC service in the default runlevel.
Configured /srv/secure and verified persistent read/write data.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed automatic recovery.
